tests.name: Full interface config with IP, description, ACL
tests.input:
interface GigabitEthernet0/0/0
 description WAN_Link_to_ISP1_CenturyLink_CID:82-HCGS-044719
 ip address 203.0.120.34 255.255.255.252
 ip access-group ACL-WAN-INBOUND in
 ip access-group ACL-WAN-OUTBOUND out
 ip flow ingress
 load-interval 30
 negotiation auto
 no shutdown

tests.name: BGP neighbor config with password and route-maps
tests.input:
router bgp 65412
 bgp log-neighbor-changes
 neighbor 10.0.0.1 remote-as 65413
 neighbor 10.0.0.1 description PEER_TRANSIT_COGENT
 neighbor 10.0.0.1 password 7 08354942071C11
 neighbor 10.0.0.1 route-map RM-TRANSIT-COGENT-IN in
 neighbor 10.0.0.1 route-map RM-TRANSIT-COGENT-OUT out
 neighbor 10.0.0.1 soft-reconfiguration inbound
 neighbor 172.16.255.2 remote-as 65412
 neighbor 172.16.255.2 update-source Loopback0
 neighbor 172.16.255.2 next-hop-self
 !
 address-family ipv4 unicast
  network 198.51.44.0 mask 255.255.252.0
  neighbor 10.0.0.1 activate
  neighbor 172.16.255.2 activate
 exit-address-family

tests.name: Route-map with prefix-list references
